msg: The gnomes' appearance is irrelevant to the forest they lead to. The colour of the gnome determines the forest that it leads to. Yellow, pink, purple and brown gnomes lead to the dark forest and orange, green, red and blue gnomes lead to the light forest. Forests seem to go through periods of having lots of mushrooms and having few mushrooms. If you are currently finding lots of mushrooms in one forest, stick with it. If the number drops below 5 with the x1 multiplier and 25 with the x5 multiplier then I found it helpful to switch forests to see if the other was more abundant. The position of the gnomes (if they are on the left or right) does not influence the forest they lead to or the number of mushrooms. Good luck in getting as many mushrooms as you can!
